# thetalake_case (Resource)

The case resource allows for the creation and management of cases within Theta Lake.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "thetalake_user" "example" {
  email = "user@example.com"
}

resource "thetalake_case" "example" {
  name        = "Example Case"
  number      = "CASE-001"
  description = "An example case managed by Terraform"
  open_date   = "2024-01-15T10:00:00Z"
  visibility  = "PRIVATE"

  manager_ids = [data.thetalake_user.example.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the case
- `number` (String) A usually-unique identifier for the case
- `open_date` (String) The open timestamp using the RFC3339 date-time format
- `visibility` (String) The visibility of the case. One of `PUBLIC` or `PRIVATE`.

### Optional

- `close_date` (String) The close timestamp using the RFC3339 date-time format. Setting this attribute closes the case as of the given timestamp. Removing it from the configuration reopens the case. Null while the case is open.
- `description` (String) A description for the case
- `manager_ids` (Set of Number) An array of user IDs assigned as managers of this case

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The created timestamp using the RFC3339 date-time format
- `id` (Number) The case ID
- `records_count` (Number) The number of records attached to this case
- `status` (String) The status of the case. One of `OPEN` or `CLOSED`.
- `updated_at` (String) The updated timestamp using the RFC3339 date-time format
